tools.name: get_shelf_price_index
tools.description: Returns one published week of the UK or Australian online shelf-price index: index levels, week-on-week change and matched-product counts by retailer and product class. It measures posted online shelf prices, not prices paid; not a CPI or a government statistic. Index levels are not price levels and

tools.name: list_index_vintages
tools.description: Lists the published weeks (vintages) of the UK or Australian online shelf-price index, newest first, with publication time, revision and base week. Returns no index values and no prices. Use it to choose a week for get_shelf_price_index.

tools.name: lookup_basket_prices
tools.description: Returns shelf-price snapshot values from the UK daily 212-item basket for up to 20 barcodes (EAN) or retailer product ids, one day, up to one row per retailer: price, was-price, loyalty price, unit price, pack size and stock, as posted. Loyalty prices appear in the basket rows only, not in the index

tools.name: list_basket_products
tools.description: Returns the identifiers of the products in the UK daily 212-item basket for one day, sorted, with paging: retailer, retailer product id and barcodes (`ean`, empty where the basket holds none, as for Aldi). No names, brands or prices. Use it to find what lookup_basket_prices can look up.

tools.name: about_the_data
tools.description: Returns the licence (CC BY 4.0) and credit form, what is not served, the store setting, the published index weeks and the basket date range with its short and missing days. The licence covers our compilation only, not retailer content. Call it before citing or relying on the other tools.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_shelf_price_index" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "get_shelf_price_index" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_shelf_price_index" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
